nodes.source_text: Jiang et al. (58) synthesized a heterostructure nanosheet composed of NiFe layered double hydroxide (LDH)/FeOOH. The as-prepared NiFe LDH/FeOOH allowed strong electron interactions at the interface and prevented the corrosion of Cl- on LDH.

nodes.source_text: Vos et al. (64) electrodeposited a thin film consisting of MnOx on the surface of IrOx to suppress the CIER (Fig. 3D). It was demonstrated that the multilayer catalyst decreased the CIER selectivity from 86% to lower than 7%.

nodes.source_text: Guo et al. (54) achieved both excellent HER activity and anti-precipitation by introducing a Lewis acid (LA) layer of CrOx on TM oxides... Notably, natural seawater without the purification or addition of buffer was used as feedstock, and 1Acm−2 was reached at 1.87 V when operated at 60 °C.

nodes.source_text: Thus, only an overpotential of 370mV was required to achieve 10mAcm-2. Moreover, the catalyst was evaluated in an anion exchange membrane AEM-based water electrolysis system, showing stable OER performance for 450 hours at 200mAcm-2.

nodes.description: OER stability improvement with SO4^2- additive in seawater
